LanguageData.VVE_Acceleration_High.description:
With swift acceleration, we move forward in leaps, seizing the day with passion.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - All vehicles have World Speed Multiplier: x1.25
LanguageData.VVE_Acceleration_High.label: high
LanguageData.VVE_Acceleration_Standard.description: Our vehicles move with balance, neither too fast nor too slow.
LanguageData.VVE_Acceleration_Standard.label: standard
LanguageData.VVE_Acceleration_SundayDriver.descriptio:
A measured pace keeps the world in balance and grants us time to savor the journey.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - All vehicles have World Speed Multiplier: x0.8
LanguageData.VVE_Acceleration_SundayDriver.label: sunday driver
LanguageData.VVE_Driving_Allowed.description: Navigating the world in vehicles is an accepted practice in our community.
LanguageData.VVE_Driving_Allowed.label: allowed
LanguageData.VVE_Driving_Approved.description: Every drive on land affirms our shared spirit and joy.
LanguageData.VVE_Driving_Approved.label: approved
LanguageData.VVE_Driving_Forbidden.description: To traverse the land in vehicles is a violation of our core beliefs.
LanguageData.VVE_Driving_Forbidden.label: forbidden
LanguageData.VVE_Driving_Horrible.description: We see setting foot in a land vehicle as a profound offense to our values.
LanguageData.VVE_Driving_Horrible.label: horrible
LanguageData.VVE_Driving_Required.description: Our people believe in the necessity of movement, to not drive is to neglect one's duty to oneself.
LanguageData.VVE_Driving_Required.label: required
LanguageData.VVE_Flying_Allowed.description: The skies are open to us, as they should be for all who wish to traverse them.
LanguageData.VVE_Flying_Allowed.label: allowed
LanguageData.VVE_Flying_Approved.description: We hold that flying brings us collectively closer to the divine.
LanguageData.VVE_Flying_Approved.label: approved
LanguageData.VVE_Flying_Forbidden.description: To soar through the skies is an affront to our traditions and beliefs.
LanguageData.VVE_Flying_Forbidden.label: forbidden
LanguageData.VVE_Flying_Horrible.description: We believe taking to the skies disrupts the natural balance.
LanguageData.VVE_Flying_Horrible.label: horrible
LanguageData.VVE_Flying_Required.description: The purity of spirit is found amongst the clouds; one must experience the freedom of flight regularly.
LanguageData.VVE_Flying_Required.label: required
LanguageData.VVE_FuelEfficiency_Efficient.description:
Our vehicles are optimized for minimal fuel usage.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - This precept decreases FuelConsumptionRate (if present) on the vehicle by 50%.
LanguageData.VVE_FuelEfficiency_Efficient.label: efficient
LanguageData.VVE_FuelEfficiency_Inefficient.descripti:
Our vehicles have a higher fuel appetite.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - This precept increases FuelConsumptionRate (if present) on the vehicle by 50%.
LanguageData.VVE_FuelEfficiency_Inefficient.label: inefficient
LanguageData.VVE_FuelEfficiency_Standard.label: standard
LanguageData.VVE_ImpactDamage_High.description:
In our belief, a vehicle's power is truly felt in its formidable impact.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Damage done via driving people over is further multiplied by x1.25
LanguageData.VVE_ImpactDamage_High.label: high
LanguageData.VVE_MaxSpeed_Increased.description:
We cherish vehicles that transcend traditional limits.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Maximum speed of vehicles is increased by a multiplier of x1.2.
LanguageData.VVE_MaxSpeed_Increased.label: increased
LanguageData.VVE_Sailing_Allowed.description: The oceans and rivers are pathways we are permitted to tread, so long as we respect their depths.
LanguageData.VVE_Sailing_Allowed.label: allowed
LanguageData.VVE_Sailing_Approved.description: We hold that Sailing brings us collectively closer to the divine.
LanguageData.VVE_Sailing_Approved.label: approved
LanguageData.VVE_Sailing_Forbidden.description: The sacred waters must not be disrupted with our vessels.
LanguageData.VVE_Sailing_Forbidden.label: forbidden
LanguageData.VVE_Sailing_Horrible.description: We hold the waters sacred; to sail them feels deeply wrong to us.
LanguageData.VVE_Sailing_Horrible.label: horrible
LanguageData.VVE_Sailing_Required.description: Our souls are intertwined with the rhythms of the waters; we must sail to truly be alive.
LanguageData.VVE_Sailing_Required.label: required
LanguageData.VVE_SmallSpaces_Horrible.description:
Being in tight quarters is an affront to our freedoms.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Doubles negative thoughts about small spaces. Positive thoughts about spacious areas are unaffected.
LanguageData.VVE_SmallSpaces_Horrible.label: horrible
LanguageData.VVE_VehicleRepairs_Fast.description:
We mend with urgency, understanding the vital role our vehicles play in our lives.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color>
 - Adds +1 to Repair Job Limitations on a vehicle (as long as "Multiple pawns per job" is active in Mod settings).
LanguageData.VVE_VehicleRepairs_Fast.label: fast
LanguageData.VVE_VehicleRepairs_Slow.description: Repairs are a careful ritual, not to be rushed, but to be performed with reverence.
LanguageData.VVE_VehicleRepairs_Slow.label: slow
LanguageData.VVE_VehicleRepairs_Standard.description: Our approach to repairs is balanced, ensuring vehicles are restored to their rightful state.
LanguageData.VVE_VehicleRepairs_Standard.label: standard
